var int firstLoaded = time
var array<float> totals = array.new<float>(20, 0.0)
var array<int> counts = array.new<int>(5, 0)
array<float> sources = array.from(close, hl2, hlc3, ohlc4)
array<float> means = array.new<float>(20, na)
int firstAnchor = timestamp("12 Dec 2018 00:00 +0000")

//@version=6
indicator("CR_Forever_SMA_three_lines_candidate", overlay = true, precision = 8)

// Authorized clean-room PARTIAL reconstruction, never protected source.
// Three numeric lines only, not a full Pifagor clone or trading strategy.
// Standard BITSTAMP:BTCUSD 1D only. No future values or price corrections.
// Plot2: 24 fixed formulas, 400 FIT / 200 Validation / 200 earlier-time Holdout.
// Public-feed max errors: $0.028095 / $0.015076 / $0.035114, not strict parity.
// Display start/end are observed boundary candidates, not proven universally.
// Signals, old2011/2010 runs, risk, labels, zones and alerts are omitted.
bool showMain = input.bool(false, "Forever sma")
int anchorMain = input.time(timestamp("12 Mar 2020 00:00 +0000"), "")
bool show2018 = input.bool(true, "2018 run")
bool show2015 = input.bool(true, "2015 run")
int anchor2018 = timestamp("14 Dec 2018 00:00 +0000")
int anchor2015 = timestamp("14 Jan 2015 00:00 +0000")
int display2015 = timestamp("01 Oct 2015 00:00 +0000")

bool supported = syminfo.tickerid == "BITSTAMP:BTCUSD" and timeframe.isdaily and timeframe.multiplier == 1
var int firstLoaded = time
var float sumMain = 0.0
var int nMain = 0
var float sum2018 = 0.0
var int n2018 = 0
var float sum2015 = 0.0
var int n2015 = 0
if time >= anchorMain
    sumMain += close
    nMain += 1
if time >= anchor2018
    sum2018 += close
    n2018 += 1
if time >= anchor2015
    sum2015 += close
    n2015 += 1

float mainLine = supported and firstLoaded <= anchorMain and time > anchorMain and nMain > 0 ? sumMain / nMain : na
// Anchor Close participates in the mean, but the2018line is hidden on anchor day.
float run2018 = supported and firstLoaded <= anchor2018 and time > anchor2018 and n2018 > 0 ? sum2018 / n2018 : na
float run2015 = supported and firstLoaded <= anchor2015 and time > display2015 and time <= anchor2018 and n2015 > 0 ? sum2015 / n2015 : na
plot(showMain ? mainLine : na, "CR Main", color = color.orange, linewidth = 1)
plot(show2018 ? run2018 : na, "CR 2018", color = color.white, linewidth = 1)
plot(show2015 ? run2015 : na, "CR 2015", color = color.white, linewidth = 1)
plot(syminfo.mintick, "DIAGNOSTIC mintick", display = display.data_window)

var table note = table.new(position.bottom_right, 1, 1)
if barstate.islast
    string message = supported ? "RESEARCH: 3 lines only. No LONG/SHORT/EXIT signals." : "Use standard BITSTAMP:BTCUSD 1D. Other contexts unvalidated."
    if supported and firstLoaded > math.min(anchor2015, math.min(anchorMain, anchor2018))
        message := "Insufficient loaded history: load data before all anchors."
    table.cell(note, 0, 0, message, text_color = color.white, bgcolor = color.new(color.black, 20))

    table.cell(status, 0, 0, "ENGINEERING ONLY", text_color=color.yellow)

strategy("Nazar Research - Trap line H1", overlay=true, initial_capital=1000,
     currency=currency.USDT, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=99,
     pyramiding=0, commission_type=strategy.commission.percent, commission_value=0.15,

     calc_on_order_fills=false, calc_on_every_tick=false, process_orders_on_close=false)
float external = input.source(close, "Select FIRST Trap line Plot")
bool armed = input.bool(false, "Confirmed external selection - enable research")
string window = input.string("FULL", "Frozen research window", options=["FULL", "EARLY", "LATE"])
int firstTime = window == "LATE" ? timestamp("UTC",2026,4,1,0,0) : timestamp("UTC",2026,1,8,0,0)
int lastTime = window == "EARLY" ? timestamp("UTC",2026,4,1,0,0) : timestamp("UTC",2026,8,1,0,0)
bool properChart = syminfo.tickerid == "BINANCE:BTCUSDT.P" and timeframe.period == "60"
bool inWindow = time >= firstTime and time < lastTime
bool canEnter = armed and properChart and inWindow and time_close < lastTime and not na(external)
var int firstLoaded = time
var int seen = 0
var int missing = 0
if barstate.isconfirmed
    if inWindow
        seen += 1
        missing += na(external) ? 1 : 0
    if canEnter
        if close > external and strategy.position_size <= 0
            strategy.entry("LONG", strategy.long, comment="Close above first Trap plot")
        else if close < external and strategy.position_size >= 0
            strategy.entry("SHORT", strategy.short, comment="Close below first Trap plot")
    else if strategy.position_size != 0
        strategy.close_all(comment="Window end or missing source")
plot(external, "External reference", color=color.orange)
var table note = table.new(position.top_right, 2, 6, bgcolor=color.new(color.black,10))
if barstate.islastconfirmedhistory or barstate.islast
    table.cell(note,0,0,"EXPLORATORY / NO FUNDING")
    table.cell(note,1,0,armed and properChart ? "ENABLED" : "NOT ENABLED")
    table.cell(note,0,1,"Window / seen / expected")
    table.cell(note,1,1,window+" / "+str.tostring(seen)+" / "+str.tostring((lastTime-firstTime)/3600000))
    table.cell(note,0,2,"Missing source bars")
    table.cell(note,1,2,str.tostring(missing))
    table.cell(note,0,3,"First loaded UTC")
    table.cell(note,1,3,str.format_time(firstLoaded,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm","UTC"))
    table.cell(note,0,4,"Repainting / edge")
    table.cell(note,1,4,"NOT VERIFIED")
    table.cell(note,0,5,"Closed trades / net USDT")
    table.cell(note,1,5,str.tostring(strategy.closedtrades)+" / "+str.tostring(strategy.netprofit,"#.########"))
    for row=0 to 5
        table.cell_set_text_color(note,0,row,color.white)
        table.cell_set_text_color(note,1,row,color.white)

                array.push(es, r * r)
                if array.size(rf) > 40

                    array.shift(es)

//@version=6
// EXPERIMENTAL_EDGE_NOT_CONFIRMED. Fixed research selection, not AI-trained inference.
// Close triggers only; risk guides are not guaranteed protective orders.
indicator("Nazar V2", overlay=true, precision=8, max_labels_count=300)
// BEGIN NAZAR_V2_CORE -- identical in Strategy, Indicator and parity fixture.
// Fixed rules selected BEFORE the chronological test. NOT a trained neural network.
// No security(), pivots, negative offsets, intrabar decisions or same-bar fills.
f_nazar(float o, float h, float l, float c, float v, int t, bool confirmed, bool inPhase) =>
    float tr = na(c[1]) ? h-l : math.max(h-l, math.max(math.abs(h-c[1]), math.abs(l-c[1])))
    float atr = ta.sma(tr, 14)
    float ma24 = ta.sma(c, 24)
    float ma96 = ta.sma(c, 96)
    float upper = ta.highest(h, 48)[1]
    float lower = ta.lowest(l, 48)[1]
    bool valid = not na(o) and not na(h) and not na(l) and not na(c) and not na(v) and l > 0 and v >= 0
    var int age = -1
    var int prevTime = na
    var int side = 0
    var bool pending = false
    var float entry = na
    var float entryAtr = na
    var float best = na
    var int held = 0
    var int cool = 0
    var int lc = 0
    var int sc = 0
    int prior = side
    int reason = 0
    float refEntry = na
    float refStop = na
    float refTake = na
    bool ready = false
    if confirmed
        bool contiguous = valid and not na(prevTime) and t-prevTime == 3600000
        age := valid ? (contiguous ? age+1 : 0) : -1
        prevTime := valid ? t : na
        ready := valid and age >= 180 and not na(atr) and atr > 0 and not na(ma96)
        if not inPhase
            side := 0
            pending := false
            lc := 0
            sc := 0
            held := 0
            cool := 0
        else if not ready
            reason := side != 0 ? 7 : 0
            side := 0
            pending := false
            lc := 0
            sc := 0
            held := 0
            cool := 8
        else
            if pending
                entry := o
                best := entry
                held := 0
                pending := false
            bool le = c > upper and ma24 > ma96
            bool se = c < lower and ma24 < ma96
            lc := le ? lc+1 : 0
            sc := se ? sc+1 : 0
            if side != 0
                held += 1
                best := side == 1 ? math.max(best,c) : math.min(best,c)
                float gain = side*(c-entry)
                float bestGain = side*(best-entry)
                float stop = entry-side*2.0*entryAtr
                if bestGain >= 2.0*entryAtr
                    stop := side == 1 ? math.max(stop,best-2.5*entryAtr) : math.min(stop,best+2.5*entryAtr)
                reason := gain <= -2.0*entryAtr ? 2 : gain >= 4.0*entryAtr ? 3 : bestGain >= 2.0*entryAtr and side*(c-best) <= -2.5*entryAtr ? 4 : (side == 1 ? sc : lc) >= 2 ? 5 : held >= 72 ? 6 : 0
                refEntry := entry
                refStop := stop
                refTake := entry+side*4.0*entryAtr
                if reason != 0
                    side := 0
                    cool := 8
                    lc := 0
                    sc := 0
            else
                if cool > 0
                    cool -= 1
                    lc := 0
                    sc := 0
                else if lc >= 2 or sc >= 2
                    side := lc >= 2 ? 1 : -1
                    entryAtr := atr
                    pending := true
                    reason := 1
                    lc := 0
                    sc := 0
    [side, reason, refEntry, refStop, refTake, confirmed and side == 1 and prior == 0, confirmed and side == -1 and prior == 0, confirmed and side == 0 and prior != 0, ready, cool, upper, lower, ma96]
// END NAZAR_V2_CORE

plot(drawChannel and supported ? upper : na,"Previous 48-bar high",color=color.new(color.teal,70))
plot(drawChannel and supported ? lower : na,"Previous 48-bar low",color=color.new(color.red,70))
plot(drawChannel and supported ? trend : na,"Trend SMA96",color=color.new(color.blue,50))
plot(side,"Audit target",display=display.data_window)
plot(reason,"Audit reason code",display=display.data_window)
var table panel = table.new(position.top_right,1,5,bgcolor=color.new(color.black,15))
